body.statement: Let \(\{\xi_{Tt},\mathcal F_{Tt}:1\leq t\leq T\}\) be a square-integrable martingale-difference array, let \(\mathcal V_T=\sum_{t=1}^T\mathbb E(\xi_{Tt}^2\mid\mathcal F_{T,t-1})\), and let \(V_T=\mathbb E(\mathcal V_T)\). If \(\mathcal V_T/V_T=1+o_P(1)\) and, for every \(\epsilon>0\), \(V_T^{-1}\sum_{t=1}^T\mathbb E[\xi_{Tt}^2\mathbf1\{|\xi_{Tt}|\geq\epsilon V_T^{-1/2}\}]=o_P(1)\), then \(V_T^{-1/2}\sum_{t=1}^T\xi_{Tt}\Rightarrow N(0,1)\).
